# get_area

## Purpose

Read one area from its ID: its title, type, summary and description. It gives no geometry and no route count; for those, pass the ID as `area_id` to [`search_routes`](search_routes.md) or [`search_waypoints`](search_waypoints.md).

## Inputs

<!-- generated:inputs start -->

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:tools from the registered input schema. Do not edit. -->

| Parameter | Type    | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --------- | ------- | -------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `id`      | integer | yes      |         | > 0         |
| `lang`    | string  | no       |         |             |

- `id`: Area ID from Camptocamp.
- `lang`: Language of titles and texts, one of: fr, en, de, it, es, ca, eu, sl, zh (default fr). Values: `fr`, `en`, `de`, `it`, `es`, `ca`, `eu`, `sl`, `zh`

<!-- generated:inputs end -->

## Related tools

- [`search_areas`](search_areas.md): find an area ID.
- [`search_routes`](search_routes.md): list the routes of the area with `search_routes {area_id}`.
- [`search_waypoints`](search_waypoints.md): list the waypoints of the area with `search_waypoints {area_id}`.
- [`search_outings`](search_outings.md): list the outings of the area with `search_outings {area_id}`.
